from mathutils import Vector, kdtree

src, out_json = args[0], args[1]

result = {
    'filepath': src,
    'blender': bpy.app.version_string,
    'frame_current': scene.frame_current,
    'frame_range': [scene.frame_start, scene.frame_end],
    'objects': [],
    'materials': [],
    'node_groups': [],
    'images': [],
    'optic': {},
    'motion': {},
    'imbue': {},
}

for obj in bpy.data.objects:
    rec = {
        'name': obj.name,
        'type': obj.type,
        'hidden': bool(obj.hide_get() or obj.hide_render),
        'parent': obj.parent.name if obj.parent else None,
        'location': [round(v, 6) for v in obj.location],
        'materials': [s.material.name if s.material else None for s in obj.material_slots],
    }
    if obj.type == 'MESH' and obj.data:
        me = obj.data
        rec.update({
            'verts': len(me.vertices),
            'faces': len(me.polygons),
            'loops': len(me.loops),
            'tris': sum(len(p.vertices) - 2 for p in me.polygons),
            'uv_layers': [uv.name for uv in me.uv_layers],
        })
        bm_non = 0
        # lightweight boundary/non-manifold via edge use
        edge_use = collections.Counter()
        for p in me.polygons:
            for e_idx in p.edge_keys:
                edge_use[e_idx] += 1
        rec['boundary_edges'] = sum(1 for c in edge_use.values() if c == 1)
        rec['nonmanifold_edges_gt2'] = sum(1 for c in edge_use.values() if c > 2)
    result['objects'].append(rec)

for m in bpy.data.materials:
    if not m.use_nodes or not m.node_tree:
        result['materials'].append({'name': m.name, 'nodes': False})
        continue
    nodes = []
    for n in m.node_tree.nodes:
        item = {'name': n.name, 'type': n.type}
        if n.type == 'TEX_IMAGE' and n.image:
            item['image'] = n.image.name
            item['colorspace'] = n.image.colorspace_settings.name
        if n.type == 'GROUP' and n.node_tree:
            item['group'] = n.node_tree.name
            item['inputs'] = {}
            for inp in n.inputs:
                try:
                    val = inp.default_value
                    if hasattr(val, '__iter__') and not isinstance(val, str):
                        item['inputs'][inp.name] = [round(float(x), 5) for x in val]
                    else:
                        item['inputs'][inp.name] = round(float(val), 5)
                except Exception:
                    pass
        if n.type == 'BSDF_PRINCIPLED':
            item['metallic_from'] = None
            item['roughness_from'] = None
        nodes.append(item)
    links = []
    for l in m.node_tree.links:
        links.append([l.from_node.name, l.from_socket.name, l.to_node.name, l.to_socket.name])
    result['materials'].append({'name': m.name, 'nodes': nodes, 'links': links})

for ng in bpy.data.node_groups:
    ins = []
    for i in ng.interface.items_tree if hasattr(ng, 'interface') else []:
        ins.append({'name': getattr(i, 'name', ''), 'item_type': getattr(i, 'item_type', ''), 'socket_type': getattr(i, 'socket_type', '')})
    result['node_groups'].append({'name': ng.name, 'nodes': [n.type for n in ng.nodes], 'interface': ins})

for im in bpy.data.images:
    result['images'].append({
        'name': im.name,
        'size': list(im.size),
        'packed': bool(im.packed_file),
        'colorspace': im.colorspace_settings.name,
    })

body = bpy.data.objects.get('Body_original_mesh')
if body and body.type == 'MESH':
    me = body.data
    world = body.matrix_world
    mat_names = [s.material.name if s.material else None for s in body.material_slots]
    by_mat = collections.Counter(mat_names[p.material_index] if p.material_index < len(mat_names) else None for p in me.polygons)
    result['optic']['body_material_faces'] = dict(by_mat)
    result['optic']['body_verts'] = len(me.vertices)
    result['optic']['body_faces'] = len(me.polygons)
    result['optic']['body_tris'] = sum(len(p.vertices) - 2 for p in me.polygons)

    frame_mat_names = [n for n in mat_names if n and 'Frame' in n]
    frame_faces = [p for p in me.polygons if p.material_index < len(mat_names) and mat_names[p.material_index] in frame_mat_names]
    frame_vert_idx = sorted({vi for p in frame_faces for vi in p.vertices})
    result['optic']['frame_materials'] = frame_mat_names
    result['optic']['frame_faces'] = len(frame_faces)
    result['optic']['frame_verts'] = len(frame_vert_idx)

    if frame_vert_idx:
        tree = kdtree.KDTree(len(me.vertices) - len(frame_vert_idx) if len(me.vertices) > len(frame_vert_idx) else len(me.vertices))
        frame_set = set(frame_vert_idx)
        other = [i for i in range(len(me.vertices)) if i not in frame_set]
        for i, vi in enumerate(other):
            tree.insert(me.vertices[vi].co, vi)
        tree.balance()
        dists = []
        for vi in frame_vert_idx:
            co = me.vertices[vi].co
            _co, _idx, d = tree.find(co)
            dists.append(d)
        dists.sort()
        result['optic']['frame_to_body_vert_dist'] = {
            'min': round(dists[0], 6),
            'p10': round(dists[max(0, int(0.1 * (len(dists) - 1)))], 6),
            'median': round(dists[len(dists) // 2], 6),
            'p90': round(dists[int(0.9 * (len(dists) - 1))], 6),
            'max': round(dists[-1], 6),
            'under_1e4': sum(1 for d in dists if d < 1e-4),
            'under_1e3': sum(1 for d in dists if d < 1e-3),
            'n': len(dists),
        }
        xs, ys, zs = zip(*[(world @ me.vertices[vi].co)[:] for vi in frame_vert_idx])
        result['optic']['frame_world_bounds'] = {
            'x': [round(min(xs), 5), round(max(xs), 5)],
            'y': [round(min(ys), 5), round(max(ys), 5)],
            'z': [round(min(zs), 5), round(max(zs), 5)],
        }

    # islands via vertex connectivity
    parent = list(range(len(me.vertices)))
    def find(a):
        while parent[a] != a:
            parent[a] = parent[parent[a]]
            a = parent[a]
        return a
    def union(a, b):
        ra, rb = find(a), find(b)
        if ra != rb:
            parent[rb] = ra
    for p in me.polygons:
        vs = list(p.vertices)
        for a, b in zip(vs, vs[1:] + vs[:1]):
            union(a, b)
    island = collections.Counter(find(i) for i in range(len(me.vertices)))
    result['optic']['body_islands'] = len(island)
    result['optic']['largest_islands'] = island.most_common(8)

for name in ('Optic_Lens', 'Optic_Reticle', 'Optic_Glass', 'Optic_Reticule'):
    pass
optic_objs = [o.name for o in bpy.data.objects if 'ptic' in o.name or 'ens' in o.name or 'etic' in o.name]
result['optic']['named_objects'] = optic_objs

# motion
ctrl_names = [n for n in ('Trigger_pivot_trial', 'TRIAL_Magazine_Control') if n in bpy.data.objects]
for frame in (1, 8, 16, 24, 40, 56, 72):
    scene.frame_set(frame)
    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
    rec = {}
    for n in ctrl_names:
        mw = bpy.data.objects[n].matrix_world
        rec[n] = [round(float(v), 6) for row in mw for v in row]
        rec[n + '_loc'] = [round(v, 6) for v in bpy.data.objects[n].matrix_world.translation]
        rec[n + '_rot'] = [round(math.degrees(v), 4) for v in bpy.data.objects[n].matrix_world.to_euler()]
    result['motion'][str(frame)] = rec

# ImbueRemaining / ElementColor
for m in bpy.data.materials:
    if not m.use_nodes:
        continue
    for n in m.node_tree.nodes:
        if n.type == 'GROUP' and n.node_tree and n.node_tree.name == 'Weapon_Element_Color':
            vals = {}
            for inp in n.inputs:
                try:
                    val = inp.default_value
                    if hasattr(val, '__iter__') and not isinstance(val, str):
                        vals[inp.name] = [round(float(x), 5) for x in val]
                    else:
                        vals[inp.name] = round(float(val), 5)
                except Exception:
                    vals[inp.name] = str(inp.default_value)
            result['imbue'][m.name] = {'group_inputs': vals}

# Color texture high-contrast dark-on-light blobs (possible leftover glyphs)
color_im = next((im for im in bpy.data.images if im.name.startswith('Color_') and im.size[0] > 0), None)
if color_im:
    w, h = color_im.size
    pix = list(color_im.pixels)
    # sample 64x64 cells for dark pixels on light background
    cw, ch = 32, 32
    cells = []
    for cy in range(ch):
        for cx in range(cw):
            x0, x1 = int(cx * w / cw), int((cx + 1) * w / cw)
            y0, y1 = int(cy * h / ch), int((cy + 1) * h / ch)
            n = (x1 - x0) * (y1 - y0)
            if n <= 0:
                continue
            lum_sum = 0.0
            dark = 0
            bright = 0
            for y in range(y0, y1, 4):
                row = y * w
                for x in range(x0, x1, 4):
                    i = 4 * (row + x)
                    r, g, b = pix[i], pix[i + 1], pix[i + 2]
                    lum = 0.2126 * r + 0.7152 * g + 0.0722 * b
                    lum_sum += lum
                    if lum < 0.18:
                        dark += 1
                    if lum > 0.55:
                        bright += 1
            samples = max(1, ((y1 - y0 + 3) // 4) * ((x1 - x0 + 3) // 4))
            mean_lum = lum_sum / samples
            if bright > samples * 0.25 and dark > samples * 0.04 and mean_lum > 0.35:
                cells.append({
                    'uv_cell': [cx, cy],
                    'mean_lum': round(mean_lum, 3),
                    'dark_frac': round(dark / samples, 3),
                    'bright_frac': round(bright / samples, 3),
                })
    cells.sort(key=lambda c: -c['dark_frac'])
    result['possible_marking_uv_cells'] = cells[:40]

with open(out_json, 'w', encoding='utf8') as f:
    json.dump(result, f, indent=2)

print('OBJECTS', len(result['objects']), 'BODY_TRIS', result['optic'].get('body_tris'), 'ISLANDS', result['optic'].get('body_islands'))
print('FRAME', result['optic'].get('frame_to_body_vert_dist'))
print('IMBUE', result['imbue'])
print('MARKING_CELLS', len(result.get('possible_marking_uv_cells', [])))

import bpy, sys
from mathutils import Vector

args = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--') + 1:]
src, dst = args[0], args[1]
bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=src)

glow = bpy.data.materials['V4_element_emission']
nt = glow.node_tree
bsdf = next(n for n in nt.nodes if n.type == 'BSDF_PRINCIPLED')
# Unlit cells were the original purple base color. Keep emission from the shared group.
for link in list(bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].links):
    nt.links.remove(link)
bsdf.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (0.027, 0.030, 0.038, 1)
bsdf.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = 0.75
bsdf.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = 0.34
orphan = next((n for n in nt.nodes if n.type == 'RGB' and n.label == 'ElementColor'), None)
if orphan and not any(l.from_node == orphan for l in nt.links):
    nt.nodes.remove(orphan)

trigger = bpy.data.objects['Trigger_Complete_Moving']
dark_name = 'Refined_dark_receiver'
if dark_name not in trigger.data.materials:
    trigger.data.materials.append(bpy.data.materials[dark_name])
dark_idx = trigger.data.materials.find(dark_name)
tripo_slots = {i for i, s in enumerate(trigger.material_slots) if s.material and s.material.name.startswith('tripo_material_')}
trig_count = 0
for p in trigger.data.polygons:
    if p.material_index in tripo_slots:
        p.material_index = dark_idx
        trig_count += 1

body = bpy.data.objects['Body_original_mesh']
cover = bpy.data.materials.get('FPS_SightHousing_Black')
if cover.name not in [s.material.name if s.material else '' for s in body.material_slots]:
    body.data.materials.append(cover)
cover_idx = body.data.materials.find(cover.name)
body_mats = [s.material.name if s.material else '' for s in body.material_slots]
stamp_count = 0
# Tiny inherited stamp above the trigger guard, player-left side. Material only; no faces deleted.
for p in body.data.polygons:
    if not body_mats[p.material_index].startswith('tripo_material_'):
        continue
    c = body.matrix_world @ p.center
    if 0.07 < c.x < 0.16 and -0.095 < c.y < -0.055 and 0.045 < c.z < 0.085:
        p.material_index = cover_idx
        stamp_count += 1

bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=dst)
print('SAVED', dst)
print('TRIGGER_DARKENED', trig_count)
print('STAMP_COVERED', stamp_count)

from mathutils import Vector

    me.materials.append(cover)
cover_idx = body.data.materials.find(cover.name)
mats = [s.material.name if s.material else '' for s in body.material_slots]

stamp_faces = []
for p in me.polygons:
    c = world @ p.center
    if 0.07 < c.x < 0.16 and -0.095 < c.y < -0.055 and 0.045 < c.z < 0.085:
        stamp_faces.append(p.index)
        if mats[p.material_index].startswith('tripo_material_'):
            p.material_index = cover_idx

bm = bmesh.new()
bm.from_mesh(me)
bm.faces.ensure_lookup_table()
bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
stamp_set = set(stamp_faces)
stamp_bm_faces = [bm.faces[i] for i in stamp_faces]
stamp_verts = {v for f in stamp_bm_faces for v in f.verts}
boundary = []
interior = []
for v in stamp_verts:
    linked = [f for f in v.link_faces]
    if any(f.index not in stamp_set for f in linked):
        boundary.append(v)
    else:
        interior.append(v)

# Plane from boundary verts in local space (least squares via average + covariance-ish normal).
if len(boundary) >= 3:
    pts = [v.co.copy() for v in boundary]
    centroid = sum(pts, Vector()) / len(pts)
    # Use average of stamp face normals as plane normal.
    n = sum((f.normal.copy() for f in stamp_bm_faces), Vector())
    if n.length > 1e-8:
        n.normalize()
        moved = 0
        max_lift = 0.0
        for v in interior:
            lift = (v.co - centroid).dot(n)
            max_lift = max(max_lift, abs(lift))
            if abs(lift) > 1e-5:
                v.co = v.co - n * lift
                moved += 1
        # Also pull boundary-adjacent stamp verts that still stick out vs neighbors outside.
        for v in list(stamp_verts):
            outs = [nv.co for e in v.link_edges for nv in (e.verts) if nv not in stamp_verts]
            if not outs:
                continue
            target = sum(outs, Vector()) / len(outs)
            delta = target - v.co
            # Only flatten along the plane normal so the panel silhouette stays.
            along = delta.dot(n) * n
            if along.length > 1e-5:

    col[y0:y1, x0 - 16:x0, :3].reshape(-1, 3),

], axis=0)

painted[y0:y1, x0:x1] = True
